content.short: Tribal Credit offers corporate cards, spend management and cross-border payments for emerging-market SMBs.
content.description: Tribal Credit is a fintech that provides corporate cards, spend management and cross-border payments to startups and small and medium businesses in emerging markets, especially across Latin America and the Middle East. It issues physical and virtual cards with granular spend controls, alongside multi-currency payments and financing that help fast-growing companies pay suppliers and manage expenses globally. Tribal has also explored blockchain and stablecoin rails for faster, cheaper international business payments, partnering with networks to move money across borders. Co-founded by entrepreneurs focused on underserved markets, it targets digital-first SMBs that struggle to access credit and modern payment tools from traditional banks.
